integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with a reproducible, standard-library finite checker; no independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean inradii of central codimension-one sections of the cube only; not affine or higher-codimension sections. Finite-dimensional law given as a Dirichlet simplex integral; endpoint asymptotics and all positive fixed moments proved analytically. Indexed-literature priority remains uncertain. Finite numerical checks are not proofs.
title: Cubic-scale inradius fluctuations and full incenter loci of random central cube sections
